inputs.locator: Decision feature: after each complete UTC day, compute Ulcer Index as the square root of mean squared percentage drawdowns from the running maximum inside the trailing completed-day close window. Compare the current value with the median of the prior 252 available Ulcer values excluding current. Current strictly above the lagged median is high risk; equality is full risk. Execute only a changed target at the next H1 open.

Frozen policy and accounting: primary uses 28 days; rejection-only neighbors use 21 and 35 days. Full risk holds 100 percent BTC; high risk holds 50 percent BTC and 50 percent zero-yield cash. Never short or lever. Rebalance only when the regime target changes, not every day to restore exact weight. Design is 2020-2022, Validation 2023-2024, annual folds 2020-2024, normal costs 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage and stress costs 20 plus 10 bps per side.

Frozen all-pass gates: positive normal and stress returns; Design drawdown at most 95 percent of buy-and-hold, upside capture at least 70 percent and Calmar at least buy-and-hold; Validation drawdown at most 90 percent, upside capture at least 70 percent, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, each state at least 60 days, 2 to 250 regime-change trades, stress drawdown at most normal plus 3pp; both neighbors positive and stable with non-worse drawdown, at least 85 percent Calmar and 65 percent upside capture; annual breadth, concentration, holding and terminal-inventory gates must all pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen daily Ulcer28 lagged-median BTC passive-core overlay on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the 28-day primary with rejection-only 21-day and 35-day neighbors under matched full-capital buy-and-hold, normal costs and stress costs. The overlay holds 100 percent BTC in lower relative path stress and 50 percent BTC plus zero-yield cash in higher relative path stress, rebalancing only when the regime target changes. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, upside, holding and terminal-inventory gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: Ulcer Index accumulates the depth and persistence of downside paths. Comparing it with its own lagged annual median may distinguish unusually persistent drawdown states, while retaining a 50-percent BTC core limits the opportunity cost of rapid recoveries.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for exact daily Ulcer21, Ulcer28 and Ulcer35 lagged-252-median 100/50-percent passive-core policies with Ulcer28 primary. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, tune a formula or gate, substitute a neighbor, create Trading behavior, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The policy is valuable only if reducing half the BTC exposure during unusually deep and persistent completed-day downside paths produces a material drawdown reduction and better Calmar without losing more than 30 percent of buy-and-hold upside, hiding performance in terminal inventory or concentrating gains in one year or realized slice.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: One frozen low-cost screen either produces a historical candidate for independent OOS or closes the exact Ulcer21/28/35 lagged-median passive-core family before optimization or runtime work consumes capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The completed-day Ulcer28 lagged-median 100/50-percent passive-core overlay improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus matched full-capital buy-and-hold in Design and historical Validation, with stable 21-day and 35-day neighbors and broad annual support.

decision_time.availability_rule: Every Ulcer input and all 252 lagged reference values are derived only from completed UTC-day closes known before the next H1 open; the current day is excluded from its reference median and no incomplete or later bar is used.

Read only the listed files, task messages and exact sealed TSV. Do not inspect another research artifact, current server state, post-2024 bar, forward outcome or OOS.
